'''Quivry hunting grounds''' were a place of interest on [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]]. [[Quivry]] were four-legged hooved antelope-like creatures, native to that [[Moon/Legends|moon]]; [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]] hunted these creatures to sharpen their senses.<ref name="TEGPM" />
